auth.label: API Key
auth.description: MemberVault API key sent as the apikey query parameter. Find it in your MemberVault admin under Integrations > Other > Webhooks API: https://intercom.help/membervault/en/articles/6868514-how-to-locate-your-account-s-api-key.

extraFields.label: Account URL
extraFields.description: Your MemberVault account subdomain or account URL. If you enter only the account name, the connector uses https://{account}.mvsite.app/api.

actions.name: add_user
actions.description: Add a user to MemberVault and optionally grant access to one product or course.

email.description: The email address of the user to add or enroll.

courseId.description: The MemberVault product or course ID. Use -1 to create the user without granting product access.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for adding a user to a MemberVault product.

anyOf.description: The MemberVault user identifier as returned by the API.

userId.description: The MemberVault user identifier when returned.

anyOf.description: A message returned by MemberVault when available.

message.description: A message returned by MemberVault when available.

raw.description: The raw MemberVault API response payload.

actions.name: delete_user
actions.description: Permanently delete a MemberVault user and their data, progress, and quiz answers.

email.description: The email address of the user to permanently delete.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for permanently deleting a MemberVault user.

anyOf.description: A message returned by MemberVault when available.

message.description: A message returned by MemberVault when available.

raw.description: The raw MemberVault API response payload.

actions.name: list_courses
actions.description: List products or courses in the connected MemberVault account.

anyOf.description: The MemberVault course identifier as returned by the API.

courseId.description: The MemberVault course identifier when available.

anyOf.description: The MemberVault product or course name when available.

courseName.description: The MemberVault product or course name when available.

raw.description: The raw course object returned by MemberVault.

items.description: A normalized MemberVault product or course.

courses.description: The MemberVault products or courses returned by the API.

raw.description: The raw MemberVault API response payload.

actions.name: remove_user
actions.description: Remove a user's access to one MemberVault product without deleting the user account.

email.description: The email address of the user whose product access should be removed.

courseId.description: The MemberVault product or course ID to remove access from.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for removing a user's access to a MemberVault product.

anyOf.description: A message returned by MemberVault when available.

message.description: A message returned by MemberVault when available.

raw.description: The raw MemberVault API response payload.
